why: The roving-focus keydown listener is bound at window capture, so a leaked one outlives its HUD and keeps claiming arrows and Escape for a panel that is gone. Scoped to the dispose file alone: run against `hud.navigation.test.ts`, every test left a listener behind that ran on every later key press, and the file took 58s locally under jsdom 30.1.1, 132s on a CI shard, and past the harness's 180s kill under jsdom 30.1.2. The walks it failed there were incidental; the dispose case is the one that names the leak.
killedBy: createHud dispose removes every capture-phase window key listener it added, by reference, on dispose
